title: Law to require standard designs for small city buildings
summary: This bill would require the Department of Design and Construction to create and maintain a catalog of pre-approved standard designs for small capital structures, such as restrooms or storage buildings, that cost no more than $10 million and are no larger than 2,500 square feet. City agencies would generally have to use a design from this catalog when building such projects, unless none can be adapted to the site. The law would take effect one year after enactment.
